newsitem.title: USA: United matches American fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: United matches American fare cuts.

text.p: United Airlines said it would match the steeply discounted air fares announced Saturday by AMR Corp's American Airlines and American Eagle units.
A United spokeswoman said the airline would match fares in markets where the two carriers compete. United is a unit of UAL Corp.

Earlier, American and its regional affiliate American Eagle said they planned an airfare sale of up to 50 percent in all U.S., Canadian and European markets for travel, and discounts of 25 to 30 percent on flights to the Caribbean. The American sale covers regular 21-day excursions on travel until May 31.
